# Community Rule Column 2 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 2 | **Condition:** complete

---

**2:1** "May-He-bless you with-all good, and-may-He-keep you from-all evil;
**2:2** and-may-He-illuminate your-heart with-the-insight-of life, and-may-He-grace you with-the-knowledge-of eternity;
**2:3** and-may-He-lift-up His-gracious face to-you for-everlasting peace."
**2:4** And-the-Levites shall-curse all the-men of-the-lot-of Belial; they-shall-take-up-speech and-say:
**2:5** "Cursed-be you in-all the-works-of your-guilty wickedness! May-God-give you over
**2:6** to-terror by-the-hand-of all the-avengers-of vengeance! May-He-visit upon-you destruction
**2:7** by-the-hand-of all those-who-repay retribution! Cursed-be you without-mercy
**2:8** according-to the-darkness-of your-deeds, and-damned-be you
**2:9** in-the-gloom-of everlasting fire! May-God not-be-gracious-to-you when-you-call, and-may-He-not-forgive
**2:10** to-atone-for your-iniquities! May-He-lift-up His-angry face for-vengeance upon-you, and-may-there-be no
**2:11** peace for-you at-the-mouth-of all those-who-hold-fast to-the-fathers!" And-after the-blessing and-the-cursing,
**2:12** all those-entering into-the-covenant shall-say: "Amen, amen."
**2:13** And-the-priests and-the-Levites shall-continue and-say: "Cursed-be the-one-who-enters
**2:14** into-this-covenant while-setting the-stumbling-blocks-of his-iniquities before-him, to-backslide upon-them.
**2:15** And-when-he-hears the-words-of this-covenant, he-blesses-himself in-his-heart, saying: 'Peace be-to-me,
**2:16** though I-walk in-the-stubbornness-of my-heart.' But-his-spirit shall-be-swept-away, the-thirsty
**2:17** together-with the-saturated, without-forgiveness. The-wrath-of God and-the-zeal-of His-judgments
**2:18** shall-burn in-him for-everlasting destruction; and-all the-curses-of this-covenant shall-cling
**2:19** to-him, and-God shall-set-him-apart for-evil, and-he-shall-be-cut-off from-the-midst-of all the-Sons-of-Light
**2:20** because-of his-backsliding from-God through-his-idols and-the-stumbling-block-of his-iniquity. He-shall-place his-lot
**2:21** in-the-midst-of the-eternally accursed. And-all those-entering into-the-covenant shall-respond
**2:22** and-say after-them: "Amen, amen."
**2:23** Thus they-shall-do year-by-year, all the-days-of the-dominion-of Belial. The-priests shall-pass-over
**2:24** first in-the-order, according-to their-spirits, one after another; and-the-Levites shall-pass-over
**2:25** after-them; and-all the-people shall-pass-over third in-the-order, one after another, by-thousands
**2:26** and-hundreds and-fifties and-tens, so-that every-man-of Israel may-know his-standing-place in-the-community-of God for-the-eternal counsel. And-no-man shall-go-down from-his-standing-place, nor-go-up from-the-place-of his-lot.

---
*EMET notes: The priestly blessing in 2:1-3 mirrors the Aaronic benediction (Num 6:24-26) with sectarian modifications. The Levitical curse in 2:5-10 is an anti-blessing, systematically inverting each element. "Lot of Belial" (goral Beliya'al) preserved as construct chain. The annual ceremony described in 2:23-26 establishes the hierarchical ordering that defines the yachad. "Spirits" (ruchot) in 2:24 refers to spiritual rank, not ghosts.*
